race.description: Afl Grand Final @ Murray Bridge Racecourse Mdn Plate
race.comment: NOAH'S ARK (3) was slowly away on debut but stuck to fence when turning for home before launching late to just miss. If he's clean away this time and settles in the same postcode, he will take plenty of stopping. STRONG MINDED (5) comes through some strong maidens and should be at his top now. Doesn't need to improve much to break through this time. SHE'S ICONNIC (11) has found two smart maiden winners to kick off the campaign. This should be a touch easier but she will still need to go to another level to win. DIVERGENT (7) comes across from Vic and has run two back that can give this a good shake. Callow's booking is a good push. RED RIPPLES (4) resumes over what looks short of a preferred trip but has jumped out well in readiness and deserves consideration. Will be hoping the pace is genuine so he can launch late.
